evidence: Added "Notes" text field via Fields dialog; it appeared in table header, card view field list, and entry add/edit form for all field types (text/number/date/checkbox already present).

Created entry with Task Name="QA Test Entry", Priority=7, Due Date=2026-09-01, Completed=true, Notes="Test note content". All values saved and shown correctly in both table (Sep 1, 2026 / check icon / text) and card views.

Fields dialog select shows clearly labeled options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox; Add Entry form renders textbox for text, spinbutton for number, date textbox for date, and a checkbox toggle labeled Yes/No for checkbox field.
Table view uses distinct lucide-check (green, text-success) icon for true and lucide-x (muted) icon for false; card/form view shows explicit Yes/No labels.
Switched Table→Cards: same 6 entries with identical field values present in both views (verified via semantic_snapshot before/after toggle).
All 6 entries and 5 fields (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) shown identically in table and card views; empty Notes value rendered as "—" in both.

issue: New entries do not persist across page reload
actual: Created entry "QA Test Entry" appeared immediately (count went 5→6). After reloading the page (http://localhost:6074/), entry count reverted to 5 and the new entry was gone; localStorage is empty (no persisted state at all), confirming the app keeps data only in memory.

evidence: Table sorted by Task Name asc then desc via header click (order & statusbar text updated correctly). Switching to Cards reset sort to unsorted/placeholder; set Cards sort to Priority ascending. Switching back to Table retained "Sorted by Task Name (descending)" independently of Cards' Priority sort.

Selecting Priority in Sort dropdown immediately reordered cards (1,1,2,2,3) and statusbar showed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)"; app remained fully interactive afterward (view switch, further clicks worked).

Before/after sorting (asc, desc, by different field), entry count stayed at 5 entries and all field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed) were unchanged for each entry, only order changed.

With no field sort active, used drag-handle (dnd-kit keyboard sortable: focus handle, Space to pick up, Arrow key to move, Space to drop) to manually reorder entry-1 in Table view (became entry-2,entry-1,entry-3,entry-4,entry-5) and separately in Cards view (became entry-2,entry-3,entry-4,entry-5,entry-1). Switching back to Table retained its own manual order, distinct from the Cards manual order, confirming per-view independence. All field values preserved.

issue: No filtering feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire toolbar, table headers, Fields dialog, and full page DOM (including hidden elements) for any filter control or the word "filter" — none found. Only a quick-search box and sort control are present. Users cannot define field-specific filter criteria at all.

issue: No filtering feature exists to verify inclusion/clearing behavior
actual: Same as FT-6: no filter UI or logic is present anywhere in the app, so filter criteria cannot be applied, verified, or cleared.

issue: Search matches only raw internal values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching "Jan 18" (the exact displayed date for the Review marketing materials entry) returned 0 matches, but searching the raw ISO value "2026-01-18" returned 1 match. Similarly, searching "Yes" (the displayed Completed state for 2 entries) returned 0 matches. Quick search clearly operates on raw stored values rather than the formatted/displayed text.

evidence: Typed "marketing" → filtered to 1 matching entry ("Review marketing materials"), statusbar showed '1 entry matching "marketing"'. Typed "MARKETING" (uppercase) → same single match, confirming case-insensitivity. Clicked clear-search → all 5 entries restored with count "5 entries".

Priority field renders as native input[type=number]. Attempting to type non-numeric text "abc" into it was rejected by the browser/Playwright itself ("Cannot type text into input[type=number]"), confirming non-numeric values cannot be entered or saved for a number field.

Due Date field renders as native input[type=date]. Setting its value to an invalid calendar date "2026-02-30" (Feb 30 does not exist) resulted in the input value being rejected and reset to empty string, confirming invalid dates cannot be saved.

issue: No import feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire toolbar, Fields dialog, and full page DOM/button list for any import/upload control. Only a static note text "Configure fields before importing data" appears in the Fields dialog, but no actual import button, file picker, or import logic exists anywhere in the app. Users cannot import data at all, so schema-based validation of imported data cannot be exercised.
